notes.title: 🎉 Now Available on MacOS! 🎉
notes.content:
I’m excited to share that Bye!Den, GO! is now live on Steam for MacOS! 

Dive into the quirky, humor-filled challenges I’ve created, each packed with absurd moments and unpredictable twists. In Bye!Den, GO!, you’ll guide President Den through a mountain of tasks, but how you handle those awkward situations will shape his legacy—or lead to delightful chaos!

For those who want to skip the toughest levels, I’ve set a small price of just $0.25 to unlock any level you’re stuck on—or unlock all levels for only $1.99 and enjoy the game’s atmosphere without having to finish each level.

Thank you for supporting indie games, and happy gaming! 🕹️💥

notes.title: Achievements Are In! Can You Unlock Them All? 🏆
notes.content:
Hey everyone! 👋

Big news – achievements have finally landed in the game, and now it's your turn to unlock them! 🎉 Whether you're trying to help President Den navigate another ridiculous situation or just embracing the chaos, there's a whole list of wild and hilarious challenges waiting for you.

Here’s a taste of what you can expect:

🕵️ Find the Secret Door – Think you've explored every corner? Think again!
🛫 Learn to Fly – Yes, you heard that right. President Den... flying? It’s possible!
⛳ Become the Best Golfer – Who's the best president on the green? Time to find out!
...and many, many more crazy tasks for you to discover!
Can you unlock all the achievements and prove you're the ultimate master of chaos? The challenge is on! 😏

A special shoutout to [b]Крутой иван[/b] who created [url=https://youtu.be/3kVvP2kVkvM?si=ZiSRo2HHkxz4cP4I]the first YouTube review[/url]! Thank you for spreading the word! 🙌

Thanks for all your amazing support and feedback. I’m just getting started, and there’s more to come, so stay tuned for future updates. Good luck out there, and don’t let Den fall too often! 😉

notes.title: Bye!Den, GO! is Officially Released! Welcome to the Game!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I'm excited to announce that Bye!Den, GO! is now officially available! 🎉 After month of hard work, the game is ready, and I can't wait for you to dive in.

What to expect:

Unique gameplay: Original mechanics, fun and challenging levels, and plenty of ridiculous moments.
Unconventional situations: Packed with humor, you'll be helping Den handle the most absurd tasks imaginable.
I hope you enjoy the game!

Feel free to share your feedback, report any bugs, or just let me know what you think.

Thank you for playing, and have fun!
